```{r}
# Load libraries and data
library(survey)
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(gtsummary)
library(gt)

# Analytic dataset 
nhanes_newvars <- readRDS(here("data", "processed", "nhanes_bmd_pediatric_newvars_rawoutcome.rds"))
# Releveled race/ethnicity category from P4_BMD_RAW
nhanes_newvars <- nhanes_newvars %>% 
  mutate(race_eth = fct_relevel(RIDRETH3, "Non-Hispanic White"))
```

```{r}
# Survey design 
nhanes_design_full <- svydesign(
  id = ~SDMVPSU,
  strata = ~SDMVSTRA,
  weights = ~WTMEC6YR,
  nest = TRUE,
  data = nhanes_newvars)

subpop_design <- subset(nhanes_design_full, subpop1 == 1)
```

```{r}
# Sensitivity analysis with physical activity added
# Indicators added in part A to account for survey design change
full_male_model_pa <- svyglm(
  DXDSTBMD ~ factor(screen_quart) + RIDAGEYR + factor(parent_edu) + factor(race_eth) + 
             INDFMPIR + BMXHT + pa_days_recode + pa_ineligible_flag,
  design = subset(subpop_design, RIAGENDR == "Male"))

summary(full_male_model_pa)

full_female_model_pa <- svyglm(
  DXDSTBMD ~ factor(screen_quart) + RIDAGEYR + factor(parent_edu) + factor(race_eth) + 
             INDFMPIR + BMXHT + pa_days_recode + pa_ineligible_flag,
  design = subset(subpop_design, RIAGENDR == "Female"))

summary(full_female_model_pa)
```
```{r}
# Original models without physical activity for comparison
full_male_model <- svyglm(
  DXDSTBMD ~ factor(screen_quart) + RIDAGEYR + factor(parent_edu) + factor(race_eth) + 
             INDFMPIR + BMXHT,
  design = subset(subpop_design, RIAGENDR == "Male"))

summary(full_male_model)

full_female_model <- svyglm(
  DXDSTBMD ~ factor(screen_quart) + RIDAGEYR + factor(parent_edu) + factor(race_eth) + 
             INDFMPIR + BMXHT,
  design = subset(subpop_design, RIAGENDR == "Female"))

summary(full_female_model)

```
